title: Report 06: what SaaS vendors claim, against what the product showed
population: Business software tools we tested hands-on in our own accounts and published a review for: 78 tools, observations 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-31.
selection: Not a sample of the market: tools from our review corpus with a free plan or trial we could open ourselves. A claim row exists only where the vendor's own page made a checkable statement about the trial, allowance or price, and we read the same thing in the product.

headline.text: vendor claims we could check in the product did not hold

metrics.label: exit tests where part of the test data did not come back in the export (at import or export)
exit tests where re-import was also tested

limitations: Not a random sample: tools we review and could open on a free plan or trial.
One account, one session per tool; a vendor can change a trial or price the next day.
A claim counts only where the same quantity could be read in the product; the rest are listed as not comparable or not checkable, not as held.
Exit tests used our own small test records; a large real account can behave differently.
next_full_recheck: with every new hands-on test round (new edition)
